writing.modelAnswer:
Dear Chris,
I'm writing to share with you an art class I had in a park last Friday.
Guided by our teacher, we spread out under an old maple tree and painted whatever caught our eyes. I chose the stone bridge across the lake, with golden leaves drifting onto the water. At first my colours looked flat and lifeless, so I mixed in a few bold touches of orange, and the scene suddenly came alive. When I put down my brush, I couldn't help smiling at it.
What struck me most was that a timid brushstroke never works. Only after I dared to add that bright orange did the lake look like autumn. That bridge taught me painting is less about copying what I see than about how I feel. I wish you'd been here!
Yours,
Li Hua

highlightExpressions.text: Guided by our teacher, we spread out
highlightExpressions.note: 过去分词短语作状语（Guided by…）开场交代背景/前提，简洁又比 With the guidance of our teacher 更地道。迁移：凡需说明“在某人带领/某条件下做某事”的应用文（活动报道、经历分享、志愿活动）都可换词复用，如 Equipped with masks, we…/Divided into groups, we…。

highlightExpressions.text: with golden leaves drifting onto the water
highlightExpressions.note: with + 名词 + 现在分词 的“with 复合结构”作伴随状语，给画面叠加动态细节，是水平二里很出彩的“够得着”结构。迁移：任何要写场景/动作伴随状态的题都能套 with + n. + doing/done，如 with music playing in the background / with the door left open。

highlightExpressions.text: I couldn't help smiling at it
highlightExpressions.note: couldn't help doing（情不自禁做某事）固定句式，用动作替代“I was very happy”空泛表态，更有画面、更真。迁移：写情绪反应/感想时通用，如 couldn't help cheering / couldn't help thinking of you。

highlightExpressions.text: What struck me most was that
highlightExpressions.note: what 引导的主语从句 + “最触动我的是……”，是从经历自然过渡到“感想/领悟”的高分框架句，避免生硬的 I think。迁移：几乎所有需要表达个人感受/收获的应用文都能用 What struck/impressed me most was that…，后接你真正的领悟。

highlightExpressions.text: painting is less about copying what I see than about how I feel
highlightExpressions.note: “X is less about A than about B”对比框架，把感悟说得有层次、有思辨味，且 less…than… 属水平二可掌握的较高结构。迁移：凡要表达“这件事的重点不在A而在B”的领悟句都可复用，如 success is less about talent than about effort。

writing.modelAnswer:
I ran back to Gunter and told him the bad news. So ashamed was I that I could hardly meet his eyes, expecting anger. Instead, he simply smiled, the same warm smile as before. "Just go and catch your bus," he said, pressing a small card with his number into my hand. "Pay me back when you can. I trust you." For a second I stood frozen, deeply moved by a stranger's kindness. Then, thanking him again and again, I raced to the bus and jumped on just as the door was closing.
Four days later, when I was back in Vienna, I called Gunter as promised. The moment he heard my voice, he laughed with delight, as if greeting an old friend. We met near the station, where I returned the money along with a small gift to show my thanks. Shaking my hand warmly, he said that helping me had simply felt right. As I watched his taxi drive away, I understood that a single act of trust between strangers can warm the coldest night.

continuationDesign.theme: 陌生人之间的善意与信任——好心人愿先付出信任，而这份信任理应用诚信回报，温暖彼此。
paragraphs: 第1段承接starter1"跑回去报坏消息"：先用一句羞愧的心理反应（部分倒装So...was I）把"我"以为会挨骂的紧张接住，制造情绪落差；再让Gunter沿用原文"big smile/We made it"的热心人设做出反转——不要钱、塞名片、说"I trust you"，把冲突（付不上钱+车要开）一举化解为"日后再还"的信任之约；以"我"被打动、飞奔上车（呼应原文一路赶车的紧张节奏）收束，留下一份待还的恩情，自然引向第2段。
第2段承接starter2"四天后依约打电话"：先用Gunter听到声音便大笑、像老友般的反应承接电话，呼应他始终如一的暖意；再写见面还钱+小礼物兑现承诺，让第1段的"信任"得到回报、形成前后呼应；结尾用环境意象点题——回扣原文开篇"又冷又湿的夜晚"与全篇反复出现的"微笑/善意"，由"a single act of trust...can warm the coldest night"升华主旨。

highlightExpressions.text: So ashamed was I that I could hardly meet his eyes, expecting anger
highlightExpressions.note: 高分记叙句：部分倒装（So+形容词+was sb that…）放在段首强化情绪，叠加非谓语expecting作伴随状语写心理预期。迁移：任何"因某情绪强烈以致做出某反应"的心理刻画都可套这个倒装框架开头，制造情绪张力。

highlightExpressions.text: he simply smiled, the same warm smile as before
highlightExpressions.note: 动作+独立名词短语同位复指：用"the same...as before"把当下动作和原文已出现的意象（微笑）勾连，既呼应人设又省字。迁移：写人物一以贯之的态度时，可用"the same X as before"回扣前文细节。

highlightExpressions.text: For a second I stood frozen, deeply moved by a stranger's kindness
highlightExpressions.note: 心理描写句：先用"stood frozen"的身体定格写震动，再用过去分词deeply moved作状语点出情绪与缘由。迁移：表现"被善意/意外击中而怔住"的瞬间，定格动作+分词状语是万能搭配。

highlightExpressions.text: Then, thanking him again and again, I raced to the bus and jumped on just as the door was closing
highlightExpressions.note: 动作链+非谓语：thanking…作伴随状语，raced/jumped连动收紧节奏，just as引导的时间状语制造"千钧一发"画面。迁移：所有"匆忙赶上某事物"的紧张收尾都可借连动+just as the…was…的卡点写法。

highlightExpressions.text: As I watched his taxi drive away, I understood that a single act of trust between strangers can warm the coldest night
highlightExpressions.note: 结尾点题句：用"watched…drive away"的目送画面收束，再以"warm the coldest night"回扣原文开篇寒夜意象完成升华。迁移：续写结尾可用"目送+一句由具体场景上升到主旨的感悟"来点题呼应。
